about_the_game:
Welcome to the Darkest Edge

You discover a sinister, cube-shaped artifact. Driven by curiosity, you open it, and the world crumbles, awakening you on the border between life and death.

Reality Blurs with the Unknown

Every place is a twisted reflection of reality. The Edge is not empty, entities from beyond death are ready to take you.

Your Mission

To escape, you must collect soul fragments scattered throughout intricate labyrinths using the artifact.

Features

  • Retro PS1 Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a nostalgic, low-poly visual style reminiscent of classic '90s PlayStation titles.

  • Entities: Face the darkness and what it hides; every threat has its own rules.

  • Compelling Objective: Gather mystical soul fragments scattered across the dimension to reclaim your essence and defy the boundary between life and death.

  • Pac-Man Inspired Gameplay: Experience an innovative, first-person twist on the classic Pac-Man formula, blending timeless nostalgia with modern dynamics.
